inclusions.text: Private hotel pickup and transfer in Hurghada
inclusions.source: The day begins with a private hotel pickup in Hurghada — the transfer is included and timed to the departure schedule, so there is no need to arrange your own way to the pier.

inclusions.text: One bottle of mineral water per person
inclusions.source: The trip takes bookings from a single seat upward, with no minimum group, and one bottle of mineral water per person is included.
